note: GMUG / Gunnison Ranger District campground 0.5 mile east of Pitkin on Cumberland Pass Road (Forest Road 765), near Quartz Creek. A base for the area's old mining-era four-wheel-drive roads in summer and fall, and a winter trailhead for snowmobiles, skiers and snowshoers. Gray-water disposal on site; no cell service. --Claude
summary: FS campground page (updated 2026-09-29) + recreation.gov: confirmed $24, first-come only, vault toilets, hand-pump drinking water, phone 970-641-0471. Changed count to 22 (FS; the note's '22-23' resolved), season now May 23 - Oct 7. Added $6 day use in fees.note and a Scan & Pay booking note. Neither the FS nor recreation.gov gives a maximum length, and recreation.gov has no per-site catalog. Note cleaned: counts, the allstays '30-ft max', reviewer rig lengths, facilities, season and FCFS dropped.
flags: No agency length figure: the FS page gives none, and recreation.gov (10165550) lists one placeholder 'site' with no length. The note's '30-ft max RV' came from allstays (aggregator), not recreation.gov; dropped from the note. max_rig_ft stays absent.
Phone 970-641-0471 confirmed: Gunnison Ranger District, 216 N. Colorado, Gunnison (GMUG offices page).

Waterfront 'not waterfront' confirmed: Quartz Creek runs between County Road 76 / FR 765 and the campground. On the Esri topo map the campground roads (Pitkin CG Rd, Pitkin CG Spur, NF-765.3E) sit ~60-200 m south of the creek line, and on NAIP imagery the loop is under dense conifer canopy with no visible channel beside any pad. Nothing shows a site on the bank, so creekside is not earned.
Status: the FS page shows 'Site Closed', in line with its May 23 - Oct. 7 season; no closure alert names Pitkin (the forest's Gold Mountain Fire order covers Ouray RD roads only).
Rate-season oddity: recreation.gov's 'First-come, First-served Season' rate runs Jul 7 - Sep 29/30 each year, narrower than the FS season of May 23 - Oct 7. Season taken from the FS statement.
Pin 38.61149,-106.50319 is by the campground turnoff (FS lat/long 38.611727,-106.503242, ~25 m away); the loop runs ~100-300 m to the southeast. OK.
Website: the stored FS link is the GMUG recreation home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/pitkin-campground-gunnison-rd.
